title: Verify CLI parses @module directive and passes module_kind to compiler
Report pre-existing parser bug: type aliases + functions fail to parse
Fix parameter type resolution order in generic functions
description: ROOTCAUSE: In get_function_declaration_type() and infer_function_declaration_type(), parameter types are resolved (line 5536-5550) BEFORE type parameters are processed (line 5557). This causes type references like 'T[]' to resolve to 'any[]' because 'T' isn't in scope yet. FIX: Either (1) process type parameters first and add them to resolution context, or (2) defer type resolution for parameters until after type parameters are processed.

title: Fix contextual keywords in v2 expression parser for function calls and expressions
description: Function declarations with contextual keyword names (from, as, of, await, yield) now work, but function CALLS still fail. Need to apply same fix in parser_v2_expression.mbt. See history/2025-12-08-contextual-keyword-fix-partial.md for details.

title: Fix: Object with next() but no Symbol.iterator should error TS2488
description:
Classes/objects with next() method but NO [Symbol.iterator]() should trigger TS2488.

Root cause: extract_iterable_element_type (lines 13011-13029) has buggy fallback that treats objects with next() as iterable even without Symbol.iterator.

Fix needed:
1. Remove the fallback code at lines 13014-13029  
2. Return (None, checker) when no Symbol.iterator found
3. Add TypeReference support in get_for_of_element_type for is_direct_iterator and has_symbol_iterator checks (currently only checks Object type)

The get_for_of_element_type function will then properly detect and error on objects with next() but no Symbol.iterator.

title: Implement TS2464 validation for generic type parameters in computed properties
description: Implement proper generic constraint validation for computed property names. Unconstrained type parameters should fail TS2464, but constrained type parameters extending string/number/symbol should pass. Affects 7 conformance tests: computedPropertyNames8, computedPropertyNames9, computedPropertyNames51, symbolProperty54 (ES5/ES6 variants). Implementation requires checking generic type parameter constraints in checker.mbt.

title: Implement TS2464 validation for interface property signatures
description: Add TS2464 validation to interface member checking to detect invalid computed property names. Currently affects 1 conformance test (symbolProperty59). Implementation needed in interface type checking section of checker.mbt.

title: Implement TS2807: Import helper version compatibility checking
description: arraySpreadImportHelpers.ts requires TS2807 diagnostic for emit helper version mismatches. Test checks that __spreadArray helper has correct number of parameters (3 vs 2). This is about code generation helpers, not type checking - low priority for type safety.

title: Fix class method return type inference for unannotated methods
description: When a class method like next() doesn't have an explicit return type annotation, the compiler should infer it from the method body. Currently returns 'any'. Example: class Iter { next() { return { value: Symbol(), done: false }; } } should infer return type as { value: symbol, done: boolean }

title: Analyze the 15 failing spread operator tests to identify patterns
description: Root cause identified: extract_iterable_element_type correctly traverses to next() method, but the method's return type is inferred as 'any' instead of the object {value: symbol, done: boolean}. This is a class method return type inference issue, not a spread operator issue. The spread validation infrastructure works correctly for arrays.
